name: prevent_valid_jsx_from_being_seen_as_the_95840557
subject: Prevent valid JSX from being seen as the start of a generic arrow function, fix crashes (#52450)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Valid JSX with an extends-style construct was mis-parsed as the start of a generic arrow function, which produced spurious errors. A parser lookahead case for SlashToken is added, and a utilities range clamp fixes a crash.
